pages.title: Cacofey
pages.text: The Cacofey is a jungle creature that steals food but helps with farming once tamed. It can also be obtained through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#sacrifice)Summoning$(/l).

pages.title: Wild Behavior
pages.text: Wild Cacofey are drawn to edible items. They will approach players, steal food, and quickly flee before consuming it. After each attempt, they rest before trying again.

pages.title: Taming
pages.text: Cacofey can be tamed using a Galeberries Cookie. Once tamed, their behavior changes entirely, becoming cooperative rather than mischievous.

pages.title: Anchoring
pages.text: Use a Hex Focus on your tamed Cacofey, then use the same Focus on the intended container. It will return there to deposit harvested items while set to wander.

pages.title: Harvesting
pages.text: When set to wander, a tamed Cacofey searches for mature crops, harvests them, and returns to its anchor to deposit the collected items.

pages.title: Modes
pages.text: Use an empty hand on your Cacofey to switch between following, staying, and wandering. Set it to wander to harvest crops and deposit them at its anchor.
